language.name: Aldervale Evening Brief
language.rationale: This design language reflects The Aldervale Institute's measured and scholarly authority, using a classic typographic voice and a restrained palette to convey calm and credibility fitting for a public-broadcast evening news.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (airy density - 33/46px padding, 16px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: glide at measured pace → preset mask-wipe
